item.title: WordPress DevKit Pro Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-14378)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-14378 / CWE-287 (Improper Authentication). Status: Weaponized — upstream documents a live-verified two-request unauthenticated admin session takeover; the archived script performs the same nonce-leak and cookie-granting POST, but was not executed during this review. Affects: DevKit Pro plugin for WordPress (dplugins), a site-development helper with a developer user-switching feature. Tags: wordpress, plugin, devkit-pro, authentication-bypass, cwe-287, nonce-leak, cookie, account-takeover, unauthenticated, php.
